title: Patch: a Jlore pill in the top bar of every signed-in screen
thread:
**Issue #1659 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1659: Patch: a Jlore pill in the top bar of every signed-in screen
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Part of #1651 (brief §1: Jlore is the premium currency). A small pill, Jlore's icon and the balance from `GET /api/wallet`, sits in the top bar next to the language and settings buttons on every screen of a signed-in person that shows the top bar; clicking it opens `/shop`. The server owns the balance (CLAUDE.md rule 7): the pill shows the wallet's answer or another answer's balance, never a sum it made.

### Where
- `apps/web/src/routes/nav.tsx` `BackLink` (~l.29–60): render the pill beside `<LanguageButton>` and `<SettingsButton>` when `showSettings` is true. The board passes `showSettings={false}` (`routes/match.tsx` ~l.471, `together/WatchRoute.tsx`, `duos/DuosRoute.tsx`, `duos/DevDuosRoute.tsx`) and draws its own controls, so the pill never shows on a board.
- `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx` (~l.410–418): the landing's own top bar, beside its two buttons.
- Signed in means a session: `readSession()` (`net/session.ts`). A visitor makes no request and sees no pill; a session whose wallet read fails (a pending account's refusal) shows none either.

### The wallet store (fixed: the store and XP parts call it)
`apps/web/src/economy/wallet.ts`:
- `useWallet(token: string | null): number | null` reads `GET /api/wallet` (`getWallet`, `net/api.ts`) when first used, on `jackioh:navigated`, when the page becomes visible again, and on every `announceWallet()`.
- `announceWallet(jlore?: number): void`: with a number (a server answer's balance, as `POST /api/packs/buy` answers `jlore`), every pill shows it at once; with none, they read the wallet again. It fires a `jackioh:wallet-changed` window event, as `announceAccountChange` (`net/gate.ts`) fires its own.
The pill counts up or down to a new value (the number only, no layout motion); reduce motion (the setting and the system's, as `game/animations.ts::reducedMotionNow` joins them) shows it at once.
`routes/DevTools.tsx` calls `announceWallet(answer.jlore)` after Give Jlore, and `announceWallet()` after its XP, quest and clear tools (a level or a quest may pay Jlore). The Shop's Buy (the store part) and a paid game (the XP client part) call it in their own files.

### Files
`apps/web/src/economy/wallet.ts`, `economy/JlorePill.tsx`, `economy/jlore-pill.css`, `economy/JlorePill.test.tsx` (new), `routes/nav.tsx`, `routes/landing.tsx`, `routes/DevTools.tsx`.

### Done when
`economy/JlorePill.test.tsx`: with a session the pill renders the wallet answer's balance; `announceWallet(140)` (a bought pack's answer) re-renders it to 140 with no request; `announceWallet()` reads the wallet again; it links to `/shop`; with no session it renders nothing and makes no request; `BackLink` with `showSettings={false}` has no pill; the landing's top bar has one. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/economy/JlorePill.test.tsx src/routes/landing.test.tsx src/routes/DevTools.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`.
Expected fallout: a test elsewhere that counts every request of a signed-in screen may see one more `GET /api/wallet`. Fix it when the test is in a file named here; otherwise leave it and name it in your report for the reconcile.

**Fullsend.** A part of #1651: it lands on `bot/issue-1651` with no checks or review of its own, beside the other parts. Change only the files named here. A check red only because a sibling part has not landed yet is expected. Leave to the reconcile the `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` entry of each new `t()` string, `apps/web/README.md`, and every e2e spec. Keep every existing test id.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-1651`, not `main` (fullsend).

Part of #1651, split by Night bot (`opus`, [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39819773251)).

2. Write `economy/wallet.ts`: a module store read through `useSyncExternalStore`, the event, and the re-read triggers in the body.
3. Write `economy/JlorePill.tsx` (icon, count up or down, a link through `followInApp(paths.shop)`, `data-testid` `jlore-pill`, an aria-label through `t()`) and `economy/jlore-pill.css` (transform and opacity only).
4. Mount it in `BackLink` when `showSettings`, and in the landing's top bar.
5. Call `announceWallet` in `routes/DevTools.tsx` after its grants.
6. Write the tests in Done when; run the commands.
```
